items.title: Spike: judge vs plain agent on triage
items.description: Rate and rank the 15 proposals that the Oct 26 reset gave verdicts. Compare an LLM with mission, MVP, and constraints against a plain agent with only the mission statement. If the plain agent matches the verdicts as well, mission-ctrl shrinks to a mission file plus one triage skill.

items.title: Gate an idea before it becomes a proposal
items.description: Before devflow creates an OpenSpec proposal, judge the idea: required for the MVP, good to have, or reject. Record rejected ideas so they are not proposed again. Build only if the spike shows value.

items.title: Rank what is next
items.description: When the user asks what is next, good-to-have proposals rank below required ones. kanban shows the order; it does not decide it. Build only if the spike shows value.
